Curate one sample's annotations and write results back to the DB

Source: R/curate_rrna.R
curate_one.Rd

Reads the reconciled annotations, the sample's curate_opts ruleset, any per-feature reference identities (blast_ref_alignment), and the sample vs. hit lineages, runs curate_rrna_core(), then updates each feature's status/flags and the per-sample annotate summary (n_flags, curate_flags) in one transaction. partial_start/partial_stop are only set (to 1) where still NULL, so a curator's own choice is kept.

Usage

curate_one(con, id, path = 1L, scaffold = 1L, ruleset = NULL, review = FALSE)

Arguments

con

Open DBI connection.

id

Sample ID.

path, scaffold

Assembly unit within the sample.

ruleset

Optional ruleset override (else read from curate_opts).

review

TRUE curates the contig's review copy: it reads and writes the review tables and replaces the copy's partial ends on every run (the user's choice is kept in partial_start_user and partial_stop_user).

Value

(invisibly) the curate_rrna_core() result.
